title: Fix RequestMetadata HMAC key corruption silently weakens audit
description:
Fix RequestMetadata HMAC key corruption silently weakens audit (Council-refined)

Source: audits/swarm-audit-synthesis-26-07-26.md

Problem: HMAC key generation/regeneration path silently overwrites or regenerates keys on detection of corruption or missing file, weakening auditability.

Acceptance criteria:
- Do not auto-regenerate HMAC keys without operator-visible audit event and backup; provide a 'recover' mode requiring explicit opt-in
- Add invariant tests and instrumentation when HMAC key file missing/corrupt
- Add documentation and startup warning when HMAC key absent

Effort: 2-4h
